transcript: I had to try my hand at making homemade hot dog buns and it was a lot easier than I thought. You just roll the dough into rounds like a bun and then take a rolling pin to flatten it and use two fingers to spread the dough before rolling it up on itself like a cinnamon roll. It sticks together and creates a perfect hot dog bun shape. I brushed them with egg wash and sprinkled them with some poppy seeds and flaky sea salt before baking them off in the oven and then brushing them with plenty of melted butter. These hot dog buns were so flavorful, plush, and soft. I stacked these paper boats along with deli sheets to make these cute little vessels that held everyone's heart. hot dogs, then filled a silver platter with pickled jalapenos, sauerkraut, a massive amount of hot dogs, chopped white onion, and all your classic hot dog condiments.
metadata_caption: Homemade hot dog buns are easier than you think, and so much softer and fluffier 🌭
